text: On or around February 4, 2022, the appellant made a "With Prejudice" resubmission of its request to amend the City's Official Plan and Zoning by-law amendment applications (File: 20 115845 NNY 08 OZ), and Site Plan Control application (File: 20115847 NNY 08 SA) following City Council's acceptance of the appellant's settlement offer that were a part of the first two applications at its meeting of December 15, 16 & 17, 2021 pursuant to the adoption of Item CC38.8.
